contentHtml:
Our research seminar focuses on applying econometric methods and theories to real-world problems. We welcome students interested in applying finance theory and statistical analysis to solve practical issues. The seminar environment is enjoyable and dynamic, fostering a collaborative learning atmosphere where everyone can expand their knowledge together.

(Accepting Double Degree)
